name: Order Restriction Type 1 Code
definition: Code indicating information about order restriction, such as the trading phase when the order becomes active.

SESR.name: Good For Closing Price Crossing Session
SESR.definition: Order qualifying for the closing price crossing session.

VFAR.name: Valid For Auction
VFAR.definition: Order being only active and can only be executed at auction phases (which can be pre-defined by the member or, participant of the trading venue who submitted the order, e.g. opening and/closing auctions and/or intraday auction).

VFCR.name: Valid For Continuous Trading Only
VFCR.definition: Order being only active during continuous trading.
